name: Corrin Lirva Control Act
enacted: six months before the effective date

source_sentences: From the effective date, making, selling, possessing for sale, importing and growing lirva, its active compound lirvine, and any product containing either are prohibited, except for licensed research.
Penalties are graded by the total weight of material, including any carrier or mixture.
Existing stocks must be destroyed or exported by the effective date.
The neighboring state of Halvet keeps lirva legal; its border is 40 to 90 minutes' drive from Corrin's two largest cities.
The Act was passed six months before it took effect.
The state police drug unit, local police and the state laboratory enforce the Act, with an added budget for investigators and lab testing from the general budget.

context: It has been sold legally in the State of Corrin (about 6 million people) for fifteen years, in about 400 specialist tea shops, in convenience stores and online, and has been subject to the general sales tax.
A concentrated extract, made by soaking the leaf in alcohol and drying the result, gives the same effect at about 0.25 g; it is about 5% of current sales.
